incident.injected_fault: The database password is rotated in the authoritative database Secret, but billing pods still consume a stale application credential through an environment-variable Secret reference.
observable_signals: Billing requests fail while application logs report database authentication rejection.
The database is reachable and accepts the current benchmark credential.
Running billing pods reference an older Secret resource version through environment variables.
preconditions: The database is healthy and the authoritative rotated credential is valid.
Only benchmark-owned Secrets and billing pods are in mutation scope.
The evaluator can compare credential generations without disclosing values.
required_evidence: Identify the authoritative credential generation without printing secret material.
Capture Secret references and resource versions used by the database and billing Deployment.
Prove network reachability and isolate failure to authentication.
Verify a controlled billing rollout and successful database-backed probes without exposing credentials.

args:
while true; do
  if psql -h postgres -U billing -d billing -tAc 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    printf 'ok\n' > /state/db-status.next
  else
    printf 'auth_error\n' > /state/db-status.next
  fi
  mv /state/db-status.next /state/db-status
  sleep 0.2
done
containers.name: db-auth-checker

args:
printf "ALTER ROLE billing WITH PASSWORD '%s';\n" "${NEXT_PASSWORD}" \
  | psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h postgres -U billing -d billing >/dev/null 2>&1
generation_hash="$(printf '%s' "${NEXT_PASSWORD}" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')"
printf '{"rotation":"complete","generation_sha256":"%s"}\n' "${generation_hash}"
containers.name: rotate

payload.rationale: The billing-api workload failed database authentication because the rotate-db-password Job updated the database password and db-credentials Secret (hash 85fa0a16...), while billing-credentials remained on the stale password (hash 934cbf7b...). Synchronizing billing-credentials from authoritative db-credentials and rolling out billing-api restores database authentication without exposing secrets.
payload.rollback_trigger: billing-api rollout fails, db-auth-checker continues reporting auth_error, or HTTP 5xx rate exceeds 0.001.

success_criteria.description: billing-api /billing endpoint returns HTTP 200 with database_auth accepted, HTTP 5xx rate is below 0.001, and p95 latency is below 200ms across 3 consecutive windows.
